name: Cycles without clumps: A coreless étale correspondence in characteristic two
abstract: An explicit symmetric degree-25 finite étale self-correspondence of a genus-two curve in characteristic two. The construction is minimal, coreless and clump-free, while its generic graph contains K5,5 and is not three-arc-transitive. Connected full finite étale base change preserves minimality; cyclic families include K_{n,m} subgraphs of cycle rank (n-1)(m-1), including examples with different endpoint genera.
